result.instruction: Replace the 32-bit counter with an 8-bit modulo-256 counter whose bit 0 toggles each active cycle and whose bit `i` toggles when all lower bits are 1; reset it synchronously to zero. Keep `pwm_out` registered with the existing `counter < duty` comparison using the pre-edge counter value, and clear it on reset. Preserve the interface and all observable behavior, including reset and output timing; do not add a numeric top latency annotation. Retain the candidate only if all verification and routed metric gates pass and its LUT/FF pair strictly improves on the feasible 7-LUT, 9-FF incumbent.
